# Robotnik

> Robotnik covers semiconductors, robotics, space, and critical materials as a single asset class — tracked through a family of indices, a map of the supply-chain control points where value and risk concentrate, and company-by-company dependency intelligence.

Robotnik's methodology is open and free. The reference library below documents how each index, rating, and classification is built; the pages are plain, ungated, citable HTML, with external figures attributed to their public sources.

## Reference library

- [The Frontier Stack thesis](https://robotnik.world/research/frontier-stack-thesis): why semiconductors, robotics, space, and critical materials form one investable asset class, read through their shared control points.
- [Universe membership methodology](https://robotnik.world/research/universe-membership): the core-business test that decides which companies are Robotnik entities, and when they enter or leave.
- [Control points](https://robotnik.world/research/control-points): how Robotnik finds the concentrated supply-chain points where value and risk gather, and maps what depends on them.
- [The Bottleneck-Weighted Index](https://robotnik.world/research/bottleneck-weighted-index): how the equity universe is reweighted towards supply risk, and how each company's exposure is rated.
- [The Public Equities Index](https://robotnik.world/research/public-equities-index): the base index — the listed frontier stack at market value, built as a blend of four sector sub-indices.
- [The Commodities Index](https://robotnik.world/research/commodities-index): how the frontier stack's raw-material inputs are weighted by demand intensity, not by tonnage and not by supply risk.
- [The Composite Index](https://robotnik.world/research/composite-index): the headline blend — three-quarters the public-equities index, one-quarter the commodities index, with the supply-risk lens kept separate.

## About

- [About Robotnik](https://robotnik.world/about): what the platform is, who it is for, and how the research is produced.
- [Robotnik home](https://robotnik.world/): the frontier stack as one asset class — indices, control points, and dependencies.
